subject: Identity perimeter & access handoff — AtlasOne onboarding
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@atlasone.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Identity perimeter & access handoff — AtlasOne onboarding

Hi Sam,

Congrats on getting the contract signed — excited to get AtlasOne into production with Redwood. This thread is to align on identity, SSO/SCIM, IP allowlists, and the service-account pattern before we kick off the implementation sprint. High-level asks below so we can scope the work and confirm owners for the kickoff on Thursday.

1) SAML/SSO
   - Please send your SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URLs, certificates) or IdP metadata file. If you prefer metadata exchange during the call, let us know.
   - We recommend enforcing NameID format urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress and mapping to user.email.

2) SCIM provisioning
   - We need to confirm whether you want full provisioning (create/modify/deactivate) or a read-only sync. If provisioning, we'll need an OAuth client or SCIM bearer token and the attribute map.

3) IP allowlists and network boundaries
   - Provide the egress IP ranges your network team will whitelist for SCIM/SAML callbacks and API webhooks. Redwood will provide our CIDR blocks; if you require per-environment ranges (staging/prod), say so.

4) Service accounts and org policies
   - Do you want a single shared service account for all Redwood calls, or per-environment service accounts (recommended)? Also confirm required role scopes for provisioning and read operations.

Attachments: I included our onboarding checklist for reference.

Goal: Have SAML metadata + SCIM scope preference + preliminary IP ranges by EOD Wednesday so we can publish the mutual action plan for Thursday's kickoff.

Thanks,
— Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood-onboard-checklist.pdf (stub)
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@atlasone.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>
Cc: atlasone-it@atlasone.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Identity perimeter & access handoff — AtlasOne onboarding

Hi Stephanie — thanks and excited to move forward. See answers inline and attached artifacts.

SAML/SSO:
- Attaching IdP metadata (atlasone-saml-metadata.xml). Our team uses Okta and the ACS URL is https://atlasone.okta.com/sso/saml2/redwood/consume. Cert thumbprint included in file.
- NameID is email and we'll map to user.email.

SCIM provisioning:
- We want full provisioning (create/modify/deactivate). We can issue a scoped SCIM bearer token for Redwood. Attached is a sample attribute map (atlasone-scim-scope.json).

IP allowlists:
- Network will whitelist Redwood production ranges. Preliminary list: 34.120.0.0/20, 34.121.16.0/20 (subject to final confirmation). We can split staging/prod later but prefer to start with prod only.

Service accounts:
- We prefer per-environment service accounts. Roles: scim:users.write, scim:users.read, webhooks:receive.

We can meet Thursday 10:00am PT for the kickoff. I've looped in atlasone-it for any network questions.

Best,
Sam
Director of IT Operations | AtlasOne
sam.walters@atlasone.com

Attachments: atlasone-saml-metadata.xml (stub); atlasone-scim-scope.json (stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.example.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.example.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Identity perimeter & access handoff — AtlasOne onboarding

Thanks for the artifacts — I pulled the metadata and the SCIM attribute map. Quick engineering notes before the kickoff:

- SAML: Okta metadata looks standard. We'll validate ACS and cert chain in our staging tenant tomorrow.
- SCIM token: ask AtlasOne to provide an HMAC-scoped bearer token with expiration or a service account we can exchange. We should request a token rotation cadence in the MAP.
- IP allowlist: the preliminary CIDRs are fine. We'll confirm which Redwood production pool owns those ranges and share the reverse listing if their firewall team prefers allow-by-hostnames.
- Service accounts: agree on per-env — we'll create distinct client IDs in our control plane and map to AtlasOne roles scim:users.* and webhooks:receive.

Action items for kickoff:
- Me: validation checklist + test user creation flow
- Ben: prepare SCIM test harness and point-in-time provisioning runbook
- Stephanie: confirm MAP + invite list, include AtlasOne network engineer and security contact

I'll draft the internal runbook snippet and post to the Drive link prior to the meeting.

— Jordan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.example.com

Subject: Re: Identity perimeter & access handoff — AtlasOne onboarding

Hi Sam — confirming Thursday 10:00am PT (30 minutes). Agenda: 1) SAML metadata validation & test user sign-in, 2) SCIM provisioning scope and token exchange, 3) IP allowlist confirmation and webhook endpoints, 4) rollout plan and rollback criteria.

Pre-kickoff asks (short):
- Please confirm the final production CIDRs by Wednesday EOD if possible.
- If you can provision the SCIM bearer token ahead of the call (or a short-lived test token), Ben can run the provisioning flow live.
- Please share the security contact for compliance questionnaires (for SOC2 evidence later).

I'll publish the MAP and meeting invite in 30 minutes. We'll record the meeting and capture the action items in the Drive folder.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Stephanie
